name: totp
title: Two-factor authentication (TOTP)
description: Authenticator-app codes (RFC 6238) on login: setup with an otpauth URL, hashed single-use recovery codes, replay protection, attempt limits. Zero dependencies.
docs:
1. POST /api/auth/2fa/setup -> { secret, otpauthUrl } (render the URL as a QR code in your app)
2. POST /api/auth/2fa/enable { code } -> { recoveryCodes } (shown once)
3. Login now answers { mfaRequired: true, mfaToken }: POST /api/auth/2fa/verify { mfaToken, code } -> { token, user }
Recovery: send { mfaToken, recoveryCode } instead of code. Disable: POST /api/auth/2fa/disable { password }.
Set CALM_ENCRYPTION_KEYS (npx calm keygen --write) so TOTP secrets are encrypted at rest.
